comment: There's better Bcomm teachers like Conn. Class is suuuuuper boring. She also gives a bunch of writing, doesn't really tell you what she wants for them, then grades super hard.

I got an A-, but I put more work into this class than any of my full-credit classes and expected nothing less than an A. She grades super by the rubric yet surprisingly harsh. Learned a great deal in terms of presentation skills, but I would not recommend this 1/2 credit class to someone else taking 4 other classes and looking for an easy A.

You only do one impromptu speech for the entire semester, so if you do it at the beginning you don't have to do the readings. Her grading for assignments can be iffy, but if you ask questions and make corrections, you can turn it in for a better grade. Her lectures are always engaging and I've learned so many skills that I can use in the future!
Very nice personality, however will stress you out with unlimited book reports, blackboard assignments etc.. Not what I exspected. Should have been titled English Writing class.
